items.known: CKV2_AWS_6 Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.issue: Public access exposure due to missing private ACL and public access block
items.remediation: Set the bucket ACL to private with `acl = "private"` and add an `aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block` resource for this bucket with `block_public_acls = true`, `ignore_public_acls = true`, `block_public_policy = true`, and `restrict_public_buckets = true`.

items.known: CKV_AWS_145 Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a `server_side_encryption_configuration` block to `aws_s3_bucket.data` with `rule { apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" } }` or `sse_algorithm = "AES256"`.

items.known: CKV_AWS_18 Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a `logging` block to `aws_s3_bucket.data` such as `logging { target_bucket = aws_s3_bucket.logs.id target_prefix = "data/" }`.

items.known: CKV_AWS_21 Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a `versioning` block to `aws_s3_bucket.data` with `enabled = true`.
